questions.question: Which property keyword makes `%Save()` fail if the property has not been set?
questions.explanation: T1.2 — `Required` enforces that a value must be present before the object can be saved.

questions.question: What does `InitialExpression` do on a property definition?

options.text: It defines the SQL index used for the property.
It sets a default value when `%New()` creates the object.
It makes the property read-only after the first save.
It converts the property into a calculated field automatically.

questions.explanation: T1.2 — `InitialExpression` provides a default value at object creation time.

questions.question: You define `Property Status As %String(VALUELIST = ",active,inactive,pending") [ Required ];`. What happens if `Status = "deleted"` when `%Save()` is called?

options.text: The invalid value is saved as-is.

questions.explanation: T1.2 — the lesson notes that `VALUELIST` enforces valid values, so `%Save()` fails for values outside the list.

questions.question: Given a property `Tags As List Of %String`, which line correctly adds an item to the list?
questions.explanation: T1.2 — the lesson shows list collections using methods such as `Insert()`, `Count()`, and `GetAt()`.

questions.question: What does the following code print?
questions.code:
SET obj = ##class(MyApp.Person).%New()
SET obj.Config.SetAt("value1", "key1")
WRITE obj.Config.GetAt("key1"), !
questions.explanation: T1.2 — `Array Of` collection properties use `SetAt(value, key)` and `GetAt(key)`.

questions.question: Which statement about `Method` and `ClassMethod` is correct?

options.text: A `ClassMethod` can use `..` self-reference just like an instance `Method`.
A `Method` is called on the class, while a `ClassMethod` is called on an instance.
A `ClassMethod` is called on the class directly, and `..` cannot be used inside it.
There is no difference in how they are called.

questions.explanation: T1.2 — the lesson explicitly notes that `..` is available in instance methods, not in class methods.

questions.question: Which lifecycle callback runs before `%Save()` and can stop the save by returning an error `%Status`?
questions.explanation: T1.2 — `%OnBeforeSave(insert As %Boolean)` is the callback used for pre-save validation.

questions.question: How do you access a class parameter named `VERSION` from inside the same class?
questions.explanation: T1.2 — the documented syntax for reading a class parameter inside the class is `..#PARAMNAME`.

questions.question: Which items are listed in the lesson as the six main types of class members? (select all that apply)
questions.explanation: T1.2 — the overview names six member categories: Properties, Methods, Parameters, Indices, XData, and Queries.

questions.question: Which statements are correct according to the lesson? (select all that apply)

options.text: A class query named `FindByAge` can be called through `FindByAgeFunc()`.
An `XData` block can hold embedded XML or JSON-style configuration.
A `ReadOnly` property is always hidden from class documentation.

questions.explanation: T1.2 — the lesson describes `Calculated` and `Transient` as non-stored, shows `FindByAgeFunc()` for class queries, and uses `XData` for embedded configuration data.
